A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same research, renamed from LlamaFusion to LMFusion. All 15 pages of each version, including equations, tables, figures, and references, support comparison. Neither supplied PDF contains an appendix.

before.justification: v1 reports original multimodal generation and understanding experiments, controlled Transfusion comparisons, architecture ablations, and image-editing examples.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experiments and reports a revised LLaVAFusion comparison, including an MME-Perception result.

M1.justification: The modality-specific attention and FFNs, frozen text modules, diffusion components, objectives, and initialization remain unchanged. LMFusion is a rename; the LLaVAFusion adaptation was already present in v1.

E1.justification: Section 5.3 and Table 2 replace MMBench with MME-Perception for LLaVAFusion evaluation. Shutterstock training, MS-COCO evaluation, language benchmarks, MMMU, ChartQA, RealWorldQA, and MagicBrush coverage remain unchanged.

E2.justification: Table 2 substantially broadens the comparator set by adding EMU-3, Show-O, Janus, Chameleon, and MetaMorph alongside Transfusion. It removes the standalone LLaVA-NeXT reference row. The main Table 1 comparison remains unchanged.

E3.justification: The reported Table 2 metric set changes: MME-P replaces MMBench scoring, and generation comparisons retain FID while dropping CLIP. The stated main training and evaluation settings remain unchanged. Missing budget and guidance labels do not establish that those underlying settings changed.

E4.justification: The architecture ablations, learning-rate sensitivity studies, and image-editing cases in Sections 5.1–5.2 and Figures 4–7 are retained. The expanded Table 2 supplies benchmark comparisons rather than a new ablation or robustness analysis.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, significance tests, or comparable uncertainty estimates. The training-curve figures introduce no new statistical reporting.

E6.justification: Table 2 substantially replaces the LLaVAFusion comparison results, adding five competing-model rows and an MME-P score of 1603.7 while removing MMBench and budget-specific FID/CLIP entries. v3 reports one LLaVAFusion FID of 8.2; v1 reports guided FIDs of 8.49 and 8.28 at different budgets, but v3 provides insufficient condition mapping to establish a performance improvement. Table 1 and the existing plotted findings are unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical formulations in Equations 1–14, including the diffusion objective and modality-specific computations, remain unchanged. No theorem, proof, or substantive derivation is added or removed.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the claims of preserving language capabilities, reusing pretrained computation, improving image understanding and generation with reduced training FLOPs, and extending the framework to vision-language models.

C2.justification: Section 5.3 shifts its interpretation from matching LLaVA-NeXT's understanding performance while adding generation to demonstrating competitiveness against other unified multimodal models. The explanations of modality separation and learning-rate tradeoffs remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Table 2 adds explicit base-LLM labels but removes the association of LLaVAFusion scores with 0.5x/1x compute budgets and the caption explicitly specifying its CFG factor of 1.6. General guidance settings remain in Section 4.3, but the revised result is less precisely identified. Other implementation and access information is retained.

R1.justification: v3 adds citations to MME, Emu3, Janus, and MetaMorph and removes the MMBench reference, expanding the positioning of the LLaVAFusion experiment. Show-O and Chameleon were already cited in v1. Section 6's broader research positioning remains unchanged.

P1.justification: LlamaFusion is renamed LMFusion throughout, the author note adds that joint-first-author order was randomly determined, and Section 5.3 and Table 2's caption receive localized rewrites. The section sequence and most prose remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Table 2 is redesigned with different rows, columns, and best-score highlighting. The unchanged Figure 2 image gallery moves from page 4 to page 2, and Figure 3's legend adopts the new name. The remaining visual content and overall layout are largely retained.

improvement.justification: The broader Table 2 comparison adds useful competitive context and MME-Perception evidence. However, it replaces the direct LLaVA-NeXT reference and detailed compute/guidance comparisons with less explicitly specified results. The PDFs do not resolve how the single new FID maps to the earlier conditions. With the method, main results, and ablations unchanged, these gains and losses do not establish a reliable net direction in overall quality.
